title: Feedback:Game updates/20251204
wikitext:
== Update, December 4, 2025 ==

* Reduced client hiccups in [[Town]]s and [[Outpost]]s with many players and high-resolution character textures selected.
* Fixed rendering issue with SSAO and some map locations ([[The Catacombs]], [[City of Torc'qua]], etc).
* Fixed [[skill icon]]s getting clipped in [[User interface#Damage monitor|damage monitor]] with HD Skills enabled.
* Fixed a crash bug in [[observer mode]] when playing with a controller or on Steam Deck.
